mapper.insert: insert into student_course_enrollment (student_id, course_id, enrollment_date, status) values (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{enrollmentDate}, #{status})
mapper.delete: delete from student_course_enrollment where student_id = #{studentId} and course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: select sce.*, s.name as studentName, c.name as courseName from student_course_enrollment sce JOIN student s ON sce.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sce.course_id = c.id where sce.student_id = #{studentId}

select sce.*, s.name as studentName, c.name as courseName from student_course_enrollment sce JOIN student s ON sce.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sce.course_id = c.id where sce.course_id = #{courseId}

select sce.*, s.name as studentName, c.name as courseName from student_course_enrollment sce JOIN student s ON sce.student_id = s.id JOIN course c ON sce.course_id = c.id
and sce.student_id = #{studentId} and sce.course_id = #{courseId} and sce.status like concat('%', #{status}, '%')
order by sce.id desc
